analysis.summaryJa: 英語の名詞は、①数えられる個体か連続した量か、②単数か複数か、③どの対象を指すかという三段階で絞り込む。可算複数の数にはmany・few、不可算名詞の量にはmuch・littleを使う。someとa lot ofは両方に使えるが、名詞自身の単複や不可算性は保たれる。さらに、一般的な複数名詞は無冠詞、初登場の可算単数はa/an、文脈や説明で特定された名詞はtheとなる。数量だけでなく、聞き手と対象を共有しているかまで確認することが自然な名詞句を作る鍵である。
grammarPoints: many・fewは可算複数名詞の個数を表し、名詞は複数形になる
much・littleは不可算名詞の量を表し、名詞に複数-sを付けない
some・a lot ofは可算複数と不可算の両方に使える
可算単数名詞は通常a/an・the・this・myなどの限定詞を必要とする
一般全体を表す可算複数は無冠詞、文脈で限定された複数はtheを伴う
a/anは未特定の一つ、theは既出・唯一・後ろの説明で特定される対象を示す
few/littleは『ほとんどない』、a few/a littleは『少しはある』という含みの差がある
visualEvidence: 三つのリングが可算性、数量、具体性を順に絞り込む流れ
birdsという一般複数とthe bird by the windowという特定対象の対比
some waterが不可算名詞の具体的だが未限定の量を示す
snowをmuchで受けるミニ確認が量として捉える判断を示す
commonTraps: many informationやmuch reportsのように数と量の数量詞を逆にする
few/littleの後ろの名詞形を確認せず、可算・不可算を取り違える
a fewとfew、a littleとlittleの肯定的・否定的な含みを混同する
可算単数を限定詞なしで置く
一般複数に不要なtheを付け、意味を特定集合に変える
既出の対象を再びa/anで導入して同一性を切ってしまう

questions.prompt: The support desk received ------- complaints after the software update.

choices.B: little
choices.C: many

questions.translationJa: ソフトウェア更新後、サポート窓口には多くの苦情が寄せられました。
questions.explanationJa: complaintsは数えられる複数名詞なので、個数の多さを表すmanyが適切です。

questions.prompt: We do not have ------- time to revise the proposal before noon.

choices.B: many
choices.C: few

questions.translationJa: 正午までに提案書を修正する時間はあまりありません。
questions.explanationJa: timeはここでは連続した量として扱う不可算名詞なのでmuchを使います。

questions.prompt: Only a ------- seats remain on the airport shuttle.

choices.B: much
choices.C: seat

questions.translationJa: 空港シャトルには席がほんの少ししか残っていません。
questions.explanationJa: seatsは可算複数で、a fewは『少しはある』という意味です。

questions.prompt: The inspection found ------- evidence of damage to the equipment.

choices.B: little
choices.C: many

questions.translationJa: 点検では設備の損傷を示す証拠はほとんど見つかりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: evidenceは不可算で、ほとんどない量を表すlittleが適切です。

questions.prompt: Please bring ------- copies of the agenda for visitors who arrive without one.

choices.C: a

questions.prompt: Ms. Chen submitted ------- proposal for extending weekend service.

choices.B: some
choices.C: a

questions.translationJa: チェンさんは週末サービス延長の提案書を1通提出しました。
questions.explanationJa: 初登場の可算単数proposalにはaが必要です。

questions.prompt: Please archive ------- invoices listed in the attached spreadsheet.

choices.B: the
choices.C: an

questions.translationJa: 添付の表計算シートに記載された請求書を保管してください。
questions.explanationJa: listed in the attached spreadsheetで対象が特定されるためtheを使います。

questions.prompt: There is too ------- traffic near the convention center during the morning rush.

choices.B: few
choices.C: a

questions.translationJa: 朝のラッシュ時、会議場の近くは交通量が多すぎます。
questions.explanationJa: trafficは流れ全体を表す不可算名詞なのでtoo muchが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: The new reservation system gives agents ------- opportunities to correct errors before confirmation.

choices.C: little

questions.translationJa: 新しい予約システムにより、担当者は確定前に誤りを修正する機会を多く得られます。
questions.explanationJa: opportunitiesは可算複数なのでmanyが適切です。

questions.prompt: The branch purchased ------- new equipment for the video-conference room.

choices.B: some
choices.C: an

questions.translationJa: 支店はビデオ会議室用に新しい設備をいくらか購入しました。
questions.explanationJa: equipmentは不可算で、未特定の量を表すsomeを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a large number of questions.

choices.A: Much participants asked questions after the presentation.
choices.B: Many participant asked question after the presentation.
choices.C: A many participants asked questions after the presentation.
choices.D: Many participants asked questions after the presentation.

questions.translationJa: 発表後、多くの参加者が質問しました。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an amount of luggage.

choices.B: We did not bring much luggage on the two-day trip.
choices.C: We did not bring much luggages on the two-day trip.
choices.D: We did not bring a luggage on the two-day trip.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about hotels in general.

choices.A: Hotels often offer early breakfast to business travelers.
choices.B: The hotels often offer early breakfast to business travelers in general.
choices.C: A hotels often offers early breakfast to business travelers.
choices.D: Hotel often offer early breakfast to business travelers.

questions.translationJa: ホテルは一般に出張者へ早朝の朝食を提供することがあります。
questions.explanationJa: 種類全体の一般論を表す複数Hotelsは無冠詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about specifically identified reports.

choices.A: Reports on the top shelf is ready for collection.
choices.B: A reports on the top shelf are ready for collection.
choices.C: The reports on the top shelf are ready for collection.
choices.D: The report on the top shelf are ready for collection.

questions.translationJa: 一番上の棚にある報告書は回収できる状態です。
questions.explanationJa: on the top shelfで特定された複数reportsにはtheを付け、動詞はareです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about one useful guide.

choices.A: The receptionist gave me an useful guide to local transportation.
choices.B: The receptionist gave me a useful guide to local transportation.
choices.C: The receptionist gave me useful guide to local transportation.
choices.D: The receptionist gave me a useful guides to local transportation.

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は地域交通について役立つ案内書を1冊くれました。
questions.explanationJa: usefulは子音音で始まり、可算単数guideにはaが必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about advice.

choices.A: The consultant offered a practical advice about inventory control.
choices.B: The consultant offered some practical advices about inventory control.
choices.C: The consultant offered many practical advice about inventory control.
choices.D: The consultant offered some practical advice about inventory control.

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントは在庫管理について実用的な助言をいくつかしました。
questions.explanationJa: adviceは不可算で、some practical adviceが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning that almost no errors occurred.

choices.A: Little errors were found during the final review.
choices.B: Few error was found during the final review.
choices.C: Few errors were found during the final review.
choices.D: A few error were found during the final review.

questions.translationJa: 最終確認では誤りはほとんど見つかりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: errorsは可算複数で、fewは『ほとんどない』を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning that almost no space remains.

choices.A: There is little space left in the storage cabinet.
choices.B: There are few space left in the storage cabinet.
choices.C: There is a few space left in the storage cabinet.
choices.D: There is little spaces left in the storage cabinet.

questions.translationJa: 保管棚には空きがほとんど残っていません。
questions.explanationJa: spaceはここでは不可算で、少ない量にはlittleを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about information specified by a phrase.

choices.A: An information in the confirmation email is accurate.
choices.B: The informations in the confirmation email are accurate.
choices.C: The information in the confirmation email is accurate.
choices.D: Information in the confirmation email are accurate.

questions.translationJa: 確認メールに記載された情報は正確です。
questions.explanationJa: informationは不可算ですが、in the confirmation emailで特定されるためtheを使い、動詞はisです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a quantity expression valid with a plural noun.

choices.A: A lot of message arrived while the system was offline.
choices.B: A lot of messages arrived while the system was offline.
choices.C: Much messages arrived while the system was offline.
choices.D: A lot messages arrived while the system was offline.

questions.translationJa: システム停止中に多くのメッセージが届きました。
questions.explanationJa: a lot ofは可算複数messagesにも使え、主語は複数なのでarrivedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Few seats are available on the evening flight."

choices.A: A large number of seats are still open.
choices.B: Almost no seats can be booked on the evening flight.
choices.C: The flight has an unlimited amount of seating.
choices.D: A little space is available for cargo only.

questions.explanationJa: few＋可算複数は『数がほとんどない』という否定的な意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We have little time before boarding begins."

choices.A: We have several boarding times to choose from.
choices.B: A few passengers have already boarded.
choices.C: Boarding will begin after a long delay.
choices.D: There is almost no time remaining before boarding.

questions.translationJa: 搭乗開始までほとんど時間が残っていません。
questions.explanationJa: little＋不可算名詞timeは『量がほとんどない』を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Many customers requested electronic receipts."

choices.A: Customers received a large amount of electricity.
choices.B: Only one customer requested many receipt paper.
choices.C: A large number of customers asked for electronic receipts.

questions.explanationJa: many customersは顧客の人数が多いことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The new service attracted much interest."

choices.A: The new service drew a great deal of interest.
choices.B: The service attracted many individual interests.
choices.C: Only a few people knew the service existed.
choices.D: The company ended the service because of one inquiry.

questions.translationJa: 新サービスは大きな関心を集めました。
questions.explanationJa: interestはここでは不可算で、muchはa great deal ofと近い意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The office ordered some equipment."

choices.A: The office ordered one equipment with an article.
choices.B: The office ordered several equipments as separate words.
choices.C: The office ordered no equipment at all.
choices.D: The office ordered an unspecified amount of equipment.

questions.translationJa: 事務所は数量を特定せず設備をいくらか注文しました。
questions.explanationJa: some＋不可算名詞は、具体的だが量を明示しないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The computers in Lab 2 need maintenance."

choices.B: One unidentified computer has already been discarded.
choices.C: The specific computers located in Lab 2 require servicing.

questions.translationJa: 第2研究室にある特定のコンピューターは整備が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: in Lab 2で集合が特定されているためthe computersです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Computers make remote collaboration easier."

choices.A: Only the previously mentioned computers are being sold.
choices.B: Computers as a general category help people collaborate remotely.
choices.C: One computer has made all offices close.
choices.D: The sentence refers to an uncountable amount of computer.

questions.translationJa: コンピューター一般は遠隔協働を容易にします。
questions.explanationJa: 無冠詞複数Computersは種類全体を一般的に述べます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "A manager called about the delayed shipment."

choices.A: The specific manager already known called again.
choices.B: All managers call about every shipment.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The manager called again this afternoon."

choices.A: An unrelated manager may call someday.
choices.B: Managers in general never use telephones.
choices.C: A large amount of management called.
choices.D: The manager already identifiable from the context made another call.

questions.translationJa: 文脈で特定できるその管理者が午後に再び電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: the managerは話し手と聞き手が同じ人物を特定できることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We received some reservations for Friday."

choices.A: We received an unspecified number of Friday reservations.
choices.B: We received much reservation as an uncountable mass.
choices.C: We received exactly one identified reservation.
choices.D: We received no reservations for Friday.

questions.translationJa: 金曜日の予約を件数を明示せずいくつか受けました。
questions.explanationJa: some＋可算複数は、ゼロではないが具体的な個数を述べない形です。

questions.prompt: The vacancy was advertised on three websites. As a result, the company received ------- applications in two days.

choices.B: much
choices.C: little

questions.explanationJa: applicationsは数えられる複数名詞なのでmanyを使います。

questions.prompt: The downtown branch has only a small lot, so there is not ------- parking available for visitors.

choices.B: few
choices.C: much

questions.explanationJa: parkingはここでは利用可能な駐車容量を表す不可算名詞なのでmuchです。

questions.prompt: The morning tour is nearly full. Only a ------- tickets can still be purchased online.

choices.B: much
choices.C: ticket

questions.explanationJa: a few＋可算複数ticketsで『少しは残っている』と表します。

questions.prompt: The notice mentions a schedule change but provides very ------- information about the reason.

choices.C: many

questions.prompt: A customer sent ------- request for wheelchair assistance with her reservation.

questions.prompt: A customer sent a request yesterday. ------- request has been forwarded to the airport staff.

choices.B: A

questions.prompt: The seminar room is short of seating. Could you move ------- chairs from Room B before noon?

choices.B: a

questions.prompt: The lobby renovation is almost complete, but we still need ------- furniture near the entrance.

choices.B: an

questions.prompt: ------- usually compare delivery dates before selecting an online retailer.

questions.explanationJa: 顧客一般について述べる可算複数Customersは無冠詞です。

questions.prompt: ------- who reported damaged packages will receive replacement items this week.

choices.B: The customers

questions.translationJa: 破損した荷物を報告した顧客には今週、代替品が届きます。
